entries.title: Balloon Fight
entries.definitive_edition: Original NES/Famicom version via high-accuracy emulation

emulation.emulator: Mesen or another high-accuracy NES emulator
emulation.notes: Use original aspect ratio and integer scaling. Avoid widescreen or graphics hacks for this arcade-style 2D title.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Accurate NES/Famicom emulation with clean digital capture

primary.version: Original NES/Famicom version via high-accuracy NES emulation
primary.why: The NES/Famicom game is the enduring home version, with later Virtual Console, NES Classic, and Nintendo Switch Online routes reissuing that NES version. For archive capture, use the original NES/Famicom release through a high-accuracy emulator for clean output; there are no platform-exclusive stages or modes in the computer, handheld, Virtual Console, or Switch Online versions.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped NES/Famicom cartridge image in a high-accuracy NES emulator such as Mesen. Capture at the original 4:3 presentation with integer scaling; use Nintendo Switch Online only as an official convenience route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later Virtual Console and Switch Online releases are NES-version reissues, not remasters. Computer and portable ports are preservation-interest routes unless exclusive content is identified later.

entries.title: Vs. Ballon Fight

emulation.emulator: Arcade Archives; MAME as preservation alternative
emulation.notes: Use the Switch Arcade Archives release for normal capture; use MAME only for cabinet-specific testing or preservation work.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official arcade rerelease or original arcade emulation

primary.why: The Switch Arcade Archives release is an official modern rerelease of the 1984 Nintendo arcade game and is the cleanest complete capture route without relying on original cabinet hardware.
primary.how_to_play: Play Arcade Archives VS. BALLOON FIGHT on Nintendo Switch; use original arcade hardware or MAME only when archival cabinet behavior is the goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: The local archive title preserves the sheet typo as 'Ballon', but the sourced game title is VS. BALLOON FIGHT.
